domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

`Nightly tiers (4/4)` is red on `a9fdb19a1d` (job 124789667673), and the red is not this PR's. The showcase shard now runs to the end in about 7.5 minutes. One Console live spec fails: `ui/e2e/live/read-only-member-record.spec.ts:107`. Its write detector counts the record page's read, `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/page`, as a write. Filed as #28618. On `main` this spec never ran: shard 1 was killed at 45 minutes before the showcase leg reached it. This PR does not change that spec or the code under it, so the red is what the new layout uncovered. No fix exists yet; it belongs to the `ui/e2e/live` lane via #28618. This PR does not re-run the job.
